# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Remove torn portions, if none do not attach.
3. Attach the test records to the form so that they both stay together.
4. Fill in the form fields accurately in the appropriate places.
5. Select one of the five reasons a safety check failed.
6. List the repairs completed in the box marked "Repairs completed".
7. Fill in appliance type and serial number in the box marked "Appliance Details".
8. Attach completed form to another record in the file room.
9. Do not return test records and forms to respective offices.
10. Log the form and record the log number on the form.<eos>
